verdict.rationale: Dropbox's Files API allows programmatic listing/downloading of all files in a user's storage (dropbox-docs-3, dropbox-gh-1), which provides a technical path to exporting one's own data, and since files are stored in their native/open formats this isn't locked into a proprietary format. However, there is no explicit account-level data export/takeover tool, GDPR-style 'download all my data' feature, or documented 'leave and take everything' flow in the evidence. Missing for 10: dedicated full-account export/data-portability tool, documentation on closing an account with data migration, independent verification that exported files retain full metadata/open formats.
